summary_1line: Sanjaya informs Dhritarashtra that Bhishma has fallen in battle, prompting the king’s grief-stricken questioning about how the seemingly invincible warrior was slain.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhishma lies on a bed of arrows upon the battlefield as the sun sets and warriors stand around the fallen grandsire.
Sanjaya stands before the blind king Dhritarashtra in the court, announcing with sorrow that Bhishma has been slain.
Bhishma, compared to a raging ocean of arrows, unleashes torrents of shafts while enemy soldiers recoil in fear.
